# hereplatform_app (Resource)

Manages a HERE platform app, the identity that owns OAuth credentials and API keys.

Deleting an app is permanent and revokes all of its credentials, so `deletion_protection` is on by default. New apps start with HERE's `restricted-iam-access` filter attached.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hereplatform_app" "example" {
  name        = "example-service"
  description = "Backend of the example service."
}

# An app allowed to create other apps, such as a deployment pipeline identity.
resource "hereplatform_app" "deployer" {
  name                 = "example-deployer"
  app_creation_enabled = true
}

# Deleting an app is permanent and revokes its credentials: set deletion_protection
# to false and apply before destroying it.
resource "hereplatform_app" "scratch" {
  name                = "example-scratch"
  deletion_protection = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name. Renaming updates the app in place and keeps its HRN and credentials.

### Optional

- `app_creation_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the app may create other apps. Requires `manage` permission on the app. Defaults to `false`. When you import an app that creates apps, such as the app the provider authenticates as, set it to `true`: otherwise the next apply turns app creation off.
- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Provider-side guard against deleting the app. While `true`, a plan that destroys the app fails (Terraform 1.3 or later), and so does any apply that would delete it, such as the replacement of a tainted app. Set it to `false` and apply before deleting the app. HERE has no such setting. Defaults to `true`.
- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) OAuth client ID of the app.
- `created_time` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `hrn` (String) HRN of the app, such as `hrn:here:account::<realm>:app/<app-id>`.
- `id` (String) HRN of the app.
- `realm` (String) Realm (organization ID) the app belongs to.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status reported by HERE.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Apps are imported by HRN. Imported apps start with deletion_protection = true.
terraform import hereplatform_app.example "hrn:here:account::myrealm:app/AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrSt"
```
